[SWS_DM_00811] Re-enabling of ControlDTCSetting by Diagnostic Application
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04159, RS_Diag_04211, RS_Diag_04067
⌈
In case the DTCSetting is disabled and the Diagnostic Server receives a call to
ara::
diag::DTCInformation::EnableControlDtc
function from the application the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall:
• enable the update of the
UDS DTC status byte
• enable the storage in event memory
• update
ara::diag::ControlDtcStatusType
to
kDTCSettingOn
⌋
Hint: The monitoring application is responsible for the re-enabling of ControlDTCSet-
ting in case some conditions or states demands so. For this purpose the applica-
tion can use the interface
ara::diag::DTCInformation
with the function
ara::
diag::DTCInformation::EnableControlDtc
.
